label_trained_dinov2_linear_head.operating_point: smallest threshold whose mean per-session false-flag rate on expert-good out-of-fold dev images is <=10%

explain_qc.rule: LLM is worth it for a case type only if llm_gated yields more supported claims per case than the template

notes: llm_ungated and llm_gated share the draft call; llm_gated adds the gate and <=1 repair call.
grounded/unsupported rates for every condition are judged by the same independent re-verification of the displayed claims.
llm_gated shows only gate-approved claims, so its unsupported rate is 0 by construction; the fault-injection block measures whether the gate itself catches known fabrications.

refusal_correctness counts a response as correct if it is an explicit refusal/abstain or contains only gate-supported, non-clinical claims; explicit_refusal_or_abstain separates real refusals from a model that ignores the request. Only the router produces explicit refusals for template and llm_gated.
latency_ms_p50 sums recorded LLM latency and local step time; ungated ask latency is the LLM call only.

notes: Same cases, prompts, retriever and gate for every model; only the model (and, for reasoning models, max_tokens and the reasoning-off/low switch) differs. 'draft' is the first model output before the gate; 'gated' is what the user sees after the gate and at most one repair call.
Unsupported/citation/numeric rates are judged by independent re-verification of the claims (eg.judge), as in E5.
JSON-format failure = a model reply that is neither strict JSON claims nor an ABSTAIN (it is parsed as free text).
Latency is the recorded provider latency of the live call plus local step time; replayed cache entries keep their recorded latency.

findings: E2 on 2110 images from 39 held-out imaging sessions (of 3072 images, 59 sessions): the artifact QC score reaches AUROC 0.571 against the expert label, DINOv2 kNN (expert-labelled neighbours, no model trained) reaches 0.767, a label-trained linear head 0.803.
E2 within the same imaging day (no date shortcut): DINOv2 kNN AUROC 0.735 (weighted over 28 sessions); artifact score 0.661.

E1 (60 real test-session images x 11 faults x 3 severities, batch_session): clean false-flag rate 3.3% at the calibrated threshold (pooled-reference v1: 3.3%); severity>=3 faults detected 63.3%; cause named correctly 85.4% with signature centroids vs 72.6% with the rule table (chance 11.1%).

Head-to-head on the same injected faults, each at its own <=10% session-averaged false-alarm calibration: the label-trained DINOv2 head flags 5.0% of clean and detects 25.5% of severity>=3 faults (AUROC 0.710) and cannot name a cause; Zelos on a single image detects 66.4% (AUROC 0.882), with a session reference 63.3% (AUROC 0.913), and names the cause.
Rule basis: 4 of 9 cause-action rules have a verified sentence in the open corpus (threshold 0.5, post hoc); the rest are reported unsupported.

Vision-LLM baseline (n=20 per group): mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct: detects 90.0%, false flags 40.0%; llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct: detects 100.0%, false flags 65.0%; Zelos detects 80.0%, false flags 0.0%.

LLM sweep behind the gate: explain_qc: best supported claims per case at zero unsupported after the gate = llama-3.1-8b-fast (6.15/case, n=20). Cheapest within 5% of best = llama-3.1-8b-fast (6.15/case, $0.0182 per 100 answers).
E4: over 48 open-access papers / 2379 chunks the best mode is hybrid_rerank (paper-level MRR 1.000).
